verifications.claim: Chuck Norris passed away on March 20, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "sudden passing of our beloved Chuck Norris yesterday morning" (announced March 20); "died Thursday morning" (family confirmed Friday); "nine days before his death" (birthday March 10)
verifications.reasoning: All sources indicate death on March 19 ("yesterday morning" on March 20 announcement), directly contradicting March 20.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris passed away at age 86.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "passed away at the age of 86"; "the 86-year-old icon died"; "Actor Chuck Norris, 86, has died"
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state he died at age 86.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm sudden hospitalization for medical emergency on Kauai.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris was on vacation at his Hawaii home when the incident occurred.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "spending time at his longtime vacation home"; "staying at his property on Kauai's North Shore for a few days before his hospitalization"
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states he was at his vacation home in Hawaii prior to hospitalization.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris was surrounded by family when the incident occurred, according to reports.

verifications.evidence: "surrounded by his family and was at peace" (refers to passing, not hospitalization); family statement about "sudden passing"
verifications.reasoning: Sources state surrounded by family at time of passing, not during the hospitalization incident; misattributes to incident.
